name: Posted Margin Or Collateral 4
definition: Information on the posted margin or collateral of the transaction.

InitialMarginPosted.name: Initial Margin Posted
InitialMarginPosted.definition: Value of the initial margin posted by the reporting counterparty to the other counterparty.|Where initial margin is posted on a portfolio basis, this field should include the overall value of initial margin posted for the portfolio.

VariationMarginPosted.name: Variation Margin Posted
VariationMarginPosted.definition: Value of the variation margin posted, including cash settled, by the reporting counterparty to the other counterparty.|Where variation margin is posted on a portfolio basis, this field should include the overall value of variation margin posted for the portfolio.

ExcessCollateralPosted.name: Excess Collateral Posted
ExcessCollateralPosted.definition: Value of collateral posted in excess of the required collateral.

OneElementPresentRule.definition: At least one element must be present.
